messages.subject: Re: geom_density, transparent bottom
parts:
The bottom line is to use stat_density() with geom_path() or geom_line().

DF <- data.frame(x = rnorm(1000))

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(DF, aes(x = x, y = ..density..)) +
theme_bw() +
geom_histogram(fill = "skyblue") +
stat_density(geom = "path", size = 1, color = "darkorange")

Dennis
